remarks: Completely private and fully gated, this single-story Mediterranean retreat is tucked away on a cul-de-sac street on a flat 16,700 sq. ft. lot. The updated 3,470 sq. ft. main residence offers 3 bedrooms and 3- 1/2 baths, plus a separate, permitted 668 sq. ft. guest house. Beautiful wood floors throughout complement a great room with vaulted ceilings, an inviting living room, and a formal dining room. The gourmet kitchen features a center island, custom cabinetry, an eight-burner Viking cooktop, and a Sub-Zero refrigerator.
